defect: G-02 (SC-3384): The two ABA (Attribute-Based / configured pricing) container filters — AttributePricingFilter (parentStep ListContainer, gate for the AttributeDiscount + AttributeBasedPrice BKM steps) and AttributePricingFilter8 (parentStep ListContainer7, gate for the AttributeDiscountEntries BKM step) — are currency-blind. Their conditionLogic contains no CurrencyIsoCode predicate, so a USD ABA override in the Attribute_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table is applied to lines of ANY currency, leaking a USD-denominated attribute price into an EUR (or other non-USD) line instead of letting that line fall through to the currency-matched PBE list price (PriceBookEntries step, which DOES pass CurrencyIsoCode into its lookup at line 115465-115470). Fix intent: gate both ABA filters to fire only when the line's CurrencyIsoCode = 'USD'.

fieldsVerified:
CurrencyIsoCode IS present as a usable context field in the V21 block, but ONLY as a BusinessKnowledgeModel parameter mapping (<name>CurrencyIsoCode</name> / <value>CurrencyIsoCode</value>), NOT as a filter sourceFieldName. Evidence within V21 (lines 110855-117766):
- Line 115465-115470 (PriceBookEntries / ListPrice step): <parameters><input>true</input><name>CurrencyIsoCode</name><output>false</output><type>Parameter</type><value>CurrencyIsoCode</value></parameters>
- Line 115648-115653 (PricingSettings step): identical CurrencyIsoCode Parameter mapping.
- The FX formula steps (lines 113134/113198/113262/113326) reference STICurrencyIsoCode (a distinct context alias), not bare CurrencyIsoCode.
Enumerated ALL AdvancedListFilter sourceFieldNames in V21: CurrencyIsoCode does NOT appear among them (grep 'sourceFieldName>CurrencyIsoCode' returns 0 matches file-wide, and 0 matches for any Currency-containing sourceFieldName in V21). However, filters DO evaluate custom line-level SObject fields — confirmed sourceFieldNames include QuoteTypeText__c, Fortra_Product_Type__c, Deal_Type__c, GSW__c, Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c, Attribute_Price_Mode__c, AllowRegionalPricing__c, COLA_Uplift_Percent__c — proving the AdvancedListFilter scope resolves against the line record's SObject fields. CurrencyIsoCode is a standard field on the pricing line SObject (QuoteLineItem/OrderItem), so it is expected to resolve as a filter sourceFieldName; but this exact usage is unprecedented in this proc.
risks:
1) SCOPE DOUBT (primary): CurrencyIsoCode has never been used as a filter sourceFieldName anywhere in this ExpressionSet — only as a BKM Parameter input. AdvancedListFilter evaluation scope may resolve sourceFieldName against the SalesTransactionContext line node rather than the raw SObject; if CurrencyIsoCode is not surfaced onto that filter-visible node, the criterion could evaluate null and, with operator Equals 'USD', would exclude EVERY line (including USD lines) — over-gating the ABA path to zero and removing attribute pricing entirely. This must be proven in the RLM canvas field picker (does 'CurrencyIsoCode' appear as a selectable filter field on these two filters?) before deploy. If it does not appear, an alternative is to surface currency via an already-mapped context variable, or add an upstream AssignmentElement stamping a line field the filter can read.
2) VALUE QUOTING: existing string Literals in these filters wrap the value in single quotes escaped as 'LastTransaction'. I mirrored that exactly with 'USD'. If the canvas actually stores standard-picklist/currency-code literals WITHOUT the surrounding single quotes for this field, the escaped quotes could cause a literal mismatch ('USD' vs USD). Verify against how a picklist/text literal is stored for CurrencyIsoCode; ItemPricingSource is the closest precedent and it uses the quoted form.
3) DEPLOY MECHANICS (from prior V21 findings): MDAPI deploy of this ESD does NOT reach the runtime pricing engine — the change must be made in the RLM canvas and activated from the Versions list; a canvas re-save on activate can clobber sibling in-place edits. These XML edits document the intended end-state to reproduce in-canvas, not a deployable artifact on their own.
4) AND-gating both filters means non-USD lines now FAIL both ABA gates and fall through to PriceBookEntries (currency-matched list). Confirm the downstream ListContainer/ListContainer7 fall-through actually yields the EUR PBE price and not a $0/null (the G-02 fix depends on a currency-matched PBE existing for the product; if none exists, the line goes to list-price-null rather than a USD leak — a different but arguably-correct failure).
5) G-02 was previously reverted in Portion-1 as 'gate-only regresses (needs PBE fallback)'. This currency-gate is the same gate-only shape; it will only be safe if the currency-matched PBE fallback is confirmed present, otherwise it reproduces the earlier regression.
